title: Thanksgiving Day Shooting at Planeta 80 Leaves 22-Year-Old Dead, Laredo's 7th Homicide of 2026
excerpt: A 22-year-old man was fatally shot in the parking lot of Planeta 80 Bar & Grill near Endeavor Drive and Polaris Drive in the early hours of Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026. It is Laredo's seventh homicide of 2026.
content:
A 22-year-old man was fatally shot in the parking lot of Planeta 80 Bar & Grill in the early hours of Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026.

The shooting happened around midnight in the parking lot of the venue, near Endeavor Drive and Polaris Drive in Laredo.

The victim was taken to a local hospital, where he later died from his injuries.

The death marks Laredo's seventh reported homicide of 2026.

The investigation remains ongoing. This is a developing story. Webb Watch 956 will update this report as more information is confirmed.

Update — November 27, 2026

Authorities arrested a suspect early Friday, Nov. 27, in connection with the fatal shooting. Authorities have not yet officially released the suspect's identity or the charges filed. The investigation continues.
